title: Customer launch workboard
service: From a validated opportunity to a shipped, learnable change
assumptions: This is a teaching snapshot, not a live delivery system
Entering Ready is the commitment point; entering Done is the delivery point
Blocked work remains in WIP; lanes show work classes, not individual performance

columns.name: Ready
columns.pull_criteria: Outcome, owner and acceptance check are clear

columns.name: In progress
columns.pull_criteria: Owner has capacity and the next step is unblocked

columns.name: Review
columns.pull_criteria: A usable result is ready for evidence-based review

policies.title: Pull
policies.rule: Pull the next item only when downstream capacity and its entry condition are both available.

policies.title: Blocked
policies.rule: Keep blocked work visible in its current state, with one owner and one next unblock action.

policies.title: Expedite
policies.rule: Allow at most one expedite item; the service owner confirms what ordinary work it displaces.

policies.title: Done
policies.rule: Evidence, acceptance check and release note are complete before an item enters Done.
